description: Age assurance attestation for AT Protocol users

main.description: Attestation proving a user has been assured as 18 years or older via government-issued ID. This record is written to the user's repository after successful assurance through the ATTPS Age Assurance service using Self Protocol's zero-knowledge proof system.

isAdult.description: Whether the user has been assured as 18 years of age or older. Always true for valid attestations.

assuredAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the assurance was performed.

assurer.description: The DID of the assurance service that performed the age assurance. Consumer apps should check this against a list of trusted assurers.

proofHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the zero-knowledge proof, prefixed with 'sha256:'. Stored for audit purposes without exposing the full proof.
